title: Over a hundred crash retrieval cases in Majic Eyes Only

tellings.quote: look at Ryan S. Wood's fantastic book, Magic Eyes Only, we can find over a hundred cases of of UFO crash retrieval.

plain: More than a hundred cases of UFO crash retrieval, meaning crashed craft being found and taken away by authorities, are collected in the book Majic Eyes Only by the researcher Ryan Wood, according to a UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. He recommends the book to Michels as evidence without going into any of the cases. If the cases hold up, they would suggest such recoveries happened many times, not just once.
